data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: grandmother
sections.question: grandmother
sections.summary: the mother of your father or mother

senses.definition: the mother of your father or mother
examples: Her grandmother is her mother's mother.
She calls her grandmother every Sunday evening.

answers.answer: Her grandmother is her mother's mother.
His grandmother is his sister's daughter.
Her grandmother is a man.
He drinks a grandmother every morning before school.

sections.title: mother
sections.question: mother
sections.summary: a female parent; a woman who has a child

senses.definition: a female parent; a woman who has a child
examples: Her mother makes breakfast for the family every morning.
She looks a lot like her mother.

answers.answer: Her mother makes breakfast for the family every morning.
His mother is his father's son.
His mother is a man.
She eats her mother for breakfast every morning.

sections.title: sister
sections.question: sister
sections.summary: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you

senses.definition: a girl or woman who has the same mother and father as you
examples: She has two sisters and one brother.
Her sister is one year younger than her.

answers.answer: She has two sisters and one brother.
His sister is his parent's son.
Her sister is the same as her brother.
He drinks his sister every morning before school.

sections.title: son
sections.question: son
sections.summary: a male child in relation to his parents

senses.definition: a male child in relation to his parents
examples: Their son is eight years old and goes to school.
She has one son and two daughters.

answers.answer: Their son is eight years old and goes to school.
Their son is a girl.
Her son is her parent, not her child.
She eats a son for breakfast every morning.

sections.title: uncle
sections.question: uncle
sections.summary: the brother of your father or mother; also the husband of your aunt

senses.definition: the brother of your father or mother, or the husband of your aunt
examples: Her uncle is her father's brother.
He visits his uncle every Christmas.

answers.answer: Her uncle is her father's brother.
His uncle is his mother's sister.
Her uncle is a woman.
He drinks his uncle every morning before school.
